provenance.source: Fictional purchase evidence for sample-mode demonstration only; not IFS source invoices.
provenance.semantics: Immutable shared dataset: identical purchase quantities apply across all reporting periods using existing pooled comparison semantics.
provenance.limitations: No monthly purchase window, replenishment, stock balance, carryover, alias resolution, or real-world invoice completeness is asserted.
provenance.selection: Fixed named cohort absent from base IFS in all six months; scenarios selected for June comparisons, not representative coverage.
provenance.holdouts: Blank CSV quantities and null manifest quantities retain unknown purchases, gaps, and percentages; they are not zero-quantity invoices.
provenance.integration: Sample-only exact dealer/product join; reject base evidence collisions; apply nonblank quantities only; preserve synthetic provenance in downstream displays and audit evidence.
provenance.activation_sources: January and April-June are existing synthetic extensions; February/March are preserved reference fixtures. This generator changes none of them.
